skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and vision of circular economy and sustainable management.
Analyze the impact of circular economy on sustainable development and economic sectors.
Apply methods and tools for resource management and circular economy strategies.
Evaluate the environmental impact of various economic activities and propose circular economy solutions.
Understand and analyze policies related to circular economy and sustainable development.
Develop teamwork skills and effective communication in a circular economy context.
Conduct research and propose solutions for circular economy challenges.
Identify and solve problems related to circular economy and sustainable development.
Evaluate the effectiveness of circular economy strategies and policies.
Prepare and deliver presentations on circular economy topics.
